title: KPI card token system and rollout strip interaction prototype
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and validate a cohesive token subset and interaction pattern for KPI metric cards and the rollout status strip used across the Redwood Console. Deliverables: token spec (spacing, type, color ramps, elevation), Figma components for KPI cards + mini graphs, interactive rollout strip prototype (canary / A/B / fallback), and a short guidance doc for engineers on implementation constraints (accessibility, responsive behaviors, token fallbacks). This ticket focuses on consistency with existing console components while introducing compact variants for dense dashboards and a persistent rollout strip that surfaces deployment state and quick actions.
acceptance_criteria: Token spec exported to Figma tokens file with semantic names (e.g., --kpi-bg-surface, --kpi-metric-strong)
KPI card component variants: standard, compact, stacked (mobile) implemented in Figma with documented props
Rollout strip prototype demonstrates: canary percentage display, manual rollback CTA, and model-variant switching with visual fallback
Accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary metric text; focus states defined for keyboard nav
Frontend engineers have a one-page implementation notes doc with CSS token mapping and expected DOM structure
comments: 2025-02-19 Marco Lin: Started component exploration in Figma. Created baseline KPI card with 3 token layers (paint, text, elevation).
2025-02-21 Sofia Alvarez (PM): Noted product constraint: rollout strip must support explicit 'snooze' action for non-critical experiments. Added to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-24 Design review: Ethan Brooks (Eng) requested smaller token increments for horizontal spacing to support dense dashboards; changed spacing scale from 8px to 4px steps for compact variants.
2025-02-27 Accessibility review: Ran color contrast checks; adjusted metric color to hit 4.6:1 on light surfaces. Documented as --kpi-metric-strong-500.
2025-03-01 UX review: PM approved interaction flows; requested microcopy for 'Rollback' confirmation. Asha to draft copy.
2025-03-02 Engineering feedback: Suggested using CSS container queries to switch to stacked variant instead of JS resize listeners. Added to implementation notes.
decisions: Adopt semantic token naming convention scoped to KPI components (kpi-*) rather than global semantic names to avoid breaking existing tokens
Use compact token set for dense dashboards: reduce horizontal padding by 50% and font-size by one step
Rollout strip will be a sticky horizontal bar with three states: monitoring (blue), degrading (amber), critical (red) and a subtle pulsing animation on state change
Prefer Figma variants + component properties over separate frames to simplify handoff
next_steps: Asha: finalize microcopy for rollback and snooze flows (due 2025-03-05)
Marco: export token JSON and hand to frontend with mapping table (due 2025-03-07)
Engineering: implement a feature-flagged rollout strip in staging for internal testing (owner: Ethan Brooks)
Design: run a short usability test (5 sessions) with PMs and SREs focusing on the rollout strip affordances
